Now, the moderator of the "Red & Black" page seems obsessed with Jemand's whiteness to the point of nihilism.

If this were a discussion taking place in a real-life anarchist forum, I have to say that I would be exiting the room and never coming back.

I'm all for fighting racism and prejudice wherever it exists--for the good of all of us, it is indeed necessary. Unfortunately, it seems counter productive to alienate whites from the movement on the basis that they are privileged. Unfortunately, this is becoming more and more accepted--at least, on the internet it sure feels that way.

There's something fishy about all of this for me. Is this "true" anarchism to you, or is radical left politics as a whole becoming co-opted by the politics of identity born out of liberal academia?
